title: Villager Sound Changer
description: This mod allows you to press F7 to open a menu where you can customize villager sounds to your preference. HOTKEYS: F7 opens the menu.
body:
This mod adds a customizable sound system for villagers, giving you full control over how they sound in-game. By pressing F7, you can open a dedicated configuration menu where you can replace, edit, or assign custom sounds to villager interactions.

Inside the menu, you can preview sounds, adjust settings, and choose which sounds play for different villager actions (such as talking, trading, or idle noises). This lets you completely personalize the atmosphere of villages, whether you want them to sound more realistic, funny, creepy, or totally unique.

The system is designed to be simple and accessible, so you can quickly switch sounds without needing any external tools or complicated setup.

HOTKEYS:

**F7 → Open/close sound customization menu**

Works: Fabric profile on 1.21.11
Not guaranteed: 1.21.10, 1.21.8, 1.21.6, 1.21.5, older 1.21.x, or 1.22
Not for: Forge or NeoForge

SOUNDS MUST BE AN OGG FILE.
